validated_results.reason: Prospective cohort reporting dietary lycopene intake (the tomato-related carotenoid exposure) and adjudicated incident renal cell carcinoma with a quartile hazard ratio.

sample_size.excerpt: In total, 96,196 postmenopausal women who enrolled in the Women's Health Initiative (WHI) between 1993 and 1998 and were followed through July 2013 were included in this analysis.
